selection: Exclude all prior project CUB species identified in existing manifests/catalogs. Shuffle eligible remaining classes and images using fixed seed. Use official train images for train/validation and official test for test. Reject exact bytes,decoded pixels or pHash<=4/dHash<=4 matches against all images of previous CUB species, prior iNaturalist files, and already accepted new images. First ten classes with sufficient nonduplicate images, without any model scores.
method: Reuse unchanged confidence_experiment.Head and train; seven arms,two frozen backbones,three seeds. Fixed24 bird attribute prompts inherited from previous training-only attribute selection;no new held-out attributes/parts/boxes used. Confidence aggregation and CAF unchanged. No original AG-CLIP reproduction claim.
holdout: Lock manifest/protocol before grounding. Ground/extract only300 train+validation images;train42 models using validation macro-F1 then CE. Seal all checkpoints and developmental assets before grounding/extracting200 held-out test images. One final scoring after seal; no test-based adaptation. Seeds vary initialization/batches;all seeds use same200 training images.
statistics: Six primary paired contrasts,weighted AG against uniform AG,text and shuffled confidence for each backbone;exact McNemar and5000 class-stratified bootstrap using three-seed probability ensemble;Holm across six. Also report seed mean/SD. A zero empirical bootstrap interval is not proof of zero population effect.
limitations: Project-unused images AND species,not necessarily new to foundation-model pretraining. Perceptual hash is heuristic;no photographer/observation grouping metadata. New bird-only domain differs from mixed iNaturalist. Same short training budget is not optimal per-model tuning. New test protects against prior test reuse but cannot guarantee absence of training overfitting.
